coder_notes: Oncolytic HSV (C134) trial; excluded intervention type at S6. Population includes recurrent GBM, grade 3/4 astrocytoma and gliosarcoma; 'glioblastoma multiforme' without IDH requirement -> historical terminology. Two sequential treatment arms, neither a control. Immune monitoring outcomes (WBC subsets, HSV titer, interferon) are not tumour molecular biomarkers.
